Plugin.Name: Thunderbolt Net
Plugin.Overview: Host-to-host networking over Thunderbolt 3/4/5 and USB4 / USB4 v2 (20G, 40G, and 80G-class hosts) wherever Linux exposes thunderbolt_net. Fabric overview, trained rate and lanes, multi-peer tbn0/tbn1… settings, services on TB IPs, known peers, harden, activity; optional OpenFabric multi-host fabric. Eth-like UX — honest trained rates (not sticker dual-lane TCP); dual-cable bonding only when multiple netdevs exist.
